# /handoff-for-test - send your lane to the tester

Read `.claude/skills/swimlanes/HANDOFF.md` first. In short:

```bash
python3 Tools/Build/handoff.py test --what "<the steps to test, the branch or build, what good looks like>"
```

`--what` is required: it is the tester's whole brief. List the editor hand tests your branch added
(`Docs/UNITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md`) in it. Commit `Docs/Handoffs/` and push (`docs(handoff): <lane> for test`).
